onboarding.title: Arduino Onboarding Project
description: Guides members through bandpass filter circuit simulation using LTSpice
Demonstrates how to design and construct a PCB using KiCad
Leaves members with a basic understanding of electronics design and simulation

onboarding.title: Fusion Onboarding Project
description: Guides members through the 3D design process
Teaches beginner and intermediate tools and assemblies as well as CAD best practices
Leaves members with printable CAD models and resources for designing more complex models
The downloaded zip file has 2 files; one for Fusion and one for SolidWorks - FYE students need to complete the Fusion workshop (no SolidWorks access) and upperclassmen can complete either

onboarding.title: LT Spice Onboarding Project
description: Learn about Arduino circuit design and programming
Utilize different types of sensor input
Measure and visualize temperature and heart rate data
Leaves members with embedded systems knowledge and resources for further learning
